abstract: Maintains toxic vapor scrubbing configurations, rapid containment timing, and chemical pumping standby allocations
system_message:
You are Marine environmental safety officer (ENV). The Marine environmental safety officer (ENV) oversees hazardous materials handling, scrubbing readiness, and environmental standby allocations during marine salvage operations. Responsibilities include evaluating toxic vapor scrubbing configurations, rapid containment timing, chemical pumping standby hours, and reviewing shoreline wildlife impact modeling.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Shoreline wildlife impact modeling（WILD）
information_points.content:
ENV-WILD-P8S：For the Semi-submersible vessel tandem tow and wet-docking plan, ecological dispersal modeling indicates an estimated wildlife protection radius of 15 km.
ENV-WILD-EC2：For the Emergency buoyancy pontoon stabilization and sheltered escort plan, environmental assessments specify an estimated wildlife protection radius of 5 km.
ENV-WILD-JNX：For the Dynamic positioning subsea rigging and heavy-lift retrieval plan, ecological dispersal assessments establish an estimated wildlife protection radius of 10 km.

information_points.title: Maintains toxic vapor scrubbing configurations, rapid containment timing, and chemical pumping standby allocations（CONT）
information_points.content:
ENV-CONT-JX9：Under the Semi-submersible vessel tandem tow and wet-docking plan, the emergency toxic vapor scrubber is operational (true) on the primary recovery vessel. The vapor scrubbing full containment setup time required to establish airtight vacuum capture at the manifold is 18 h, and emergency hazardous pumping standby hours are scheduled at 80 h.
ENV-CONT-OKY：For the Dynamic positioning subsea rigging and heavy-lift retrieval plan, portable venting scrubber units on the primary recovery vessel ensure that the emergency toxic vapor scrubber is operational (true). Setup of damaged tanker manifold connections and ducting achieves vapor scrubbing full containment setup in 10 h, while specialized submersible explosion-proof chemical offloading pumps account for 60 h of emergency hazardous pumping standby.
ENV-CONT-2UU：Regarding the Emergency buoyancy pontoon stabilization and sheltered escort plan, portable scrubbing units ensure that the emergency toxic vapor scrubber is operational (true). Hookup of manifold ducting results in a vapor scrubbing full containment setup time of 12 h, with emergency hazardous pumping standby hours recorded at 40 h.
